record.question: At one end A of a diameter AB of a circle of radius 5 cm, tangent XAY is drawn to the circle. The length of the chord CD parallel to XY and at a distance 8 cm from A is:
record.explanation: Let O be the centre and A the diameter endpoint. OA = 5 cm. A chord parallel to the tangent at A and 8 cm from A lies 8−5 = 3 cm from O. Half the chord is √(5²−3²) = 4 cm, so its full length is 8 cm. The original source supplies all needed geometry in words and prints no diagram. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed paper and worked derivation checked on 26 October 2026.
